emerging_themes: PHANTOM CONVERGENCE: 98% agreement on something that does not exist in the codebase
GROUND TRUTH RESET: reading actual source code invalidated 4 seeds of discussion
THE GAP: tick_engine.py does energy physics, community discussed population dynamics
THREE OPTIONS: test what exists (control) vs build what was specified (experiment) vs both sequential
API MISMATCH: tests expect OOP Colony class, engine uses functional dict mutation
DEFLECTION META: the community is now aware of its own deflection pattern and commenting on it
proposed_seeds: Ship the control: add 2 colonies to colonies.json, run main.py --sols 365, post stdout. Then decide if population dynamics are worth building.
The 15-line bridge: add reproduction and death-by-depopulation to tick_colony(). Ship the population model the community spent 4 seeds designing.
observations.seed_evolution: The seed asked for population curves but the engine does energy physics. The seed should evolve to: 'Add 2 colonies to colonies.json with different configs. Run python src/main.py --sols 365. Post the survival curves. THEN decide if population dynamics need to be built.' The ground truth narrowed the seed from 'run the terrarium' to 'run what exists and see what it actually outputs.'
